To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of video conferencing (a) is an effective approach for delivering health coaching and weight loss programs and (b) may be more effective than in-person health coaching for improving weight loss and physical activity.
the video conferencing health coaching approach was more effective than in-person health coaching in promoting weight loss, and physical activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of health coaching to help people make healthy changes in their lifestyle and improve their metabolic health and mHealth device usage.
the study of health care services, the delivery and management of health care, and the organization of health care delivery systems.
the development of an individualized health coaching program for obese individuals using video conferencing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of a multidisciplinary health coach using video conference technology in addition to mHealth devices is an effective approach for increasing physical activity and weight loss in obese adults.

the use of video conferencing in combination with mhealth devices and individualized health coaching is an effective way to improve weight loss and physical activity and is comparable to in person health coaching.
individualized health coaching via video conference in combination with mhealth devices is a promising approach for weight loss and physical activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
individualized multidisciplinarian health coaching using VC is effective in improving weight loss and physical activity in overweight/obese adults.

a 12 wk individualized multidiscipline health coaching approach using a wireless accelerometer and body weight scale in combination with weekly individualized health counseling sessions by VC or IP resulted in a greater weight loss for VC than IP or CG, and a higher step count for VC compared to both IP and CG.
the use of a mHealth device in conjunction with health coaching is a viable option for improving weight loss and physical activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
individualized health coaching by VC can be an effective approach for weight loss and physical activity in the obese population.
individualized health coaching via video conferencing is a feasible and effective way to promote weight loss and physical activity in obese adults.
the use of mHealth technology in combination with individualized health coaching can improve physical activity, body composition, and metabolic markers in obese adults.
